WoWFA Forever 1.0.0-rc4 (test build, built by wowfa2 CI).

Fixes from the rc3 miss list: talent tooltips without spell data (the Forever talent frame) now translate, female-character spell texts match, general / racial / profession spells (Attack, Dodge, Parry, Shadowmeld, Elune's Light, First Aid, Fishing...) have Persian, the zone label no longer re-reads its own Persian, and /wowfa > Status shows the reason next to each state.
